audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagreed with the packet chart and with their own whys — Level 2 was Skill (whys[1]: "his Q charges plus W keep out-trading"), Levels 3 and 4-5 were Yone (whys[2]/whys[3]: "even out", "stays skill-based"), Level 6 was K'Sante (whys[4]: "remains a coin-flip").
audit.why: Packet chart reads K'Sante, K'Sante, Skill, Skill, Skill, Yone, Yone, and the mirror audit set all seven rows to exactly that.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to K'Sante, rows 2, 3 and 4 to Skill on BOTH layers as one group, with the phase whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and mid both claim All Out "shreds your armour"; the page carries no cooldown for either ultimate.
audit.why: Riot's R text gives K'Sante increased damage, healing and transformed abilities "at the cost of reduced defenses" — the resistance loss is HIS, not yours. There is no armour shred in the kit. Both ultimates are 120s at rank 1, which is the real level-6 symmetry.
audit.corrected: Replaced the armour-shred claim with what All Out actually does, and put 120s on both ultimates in phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly describes a "Q3 wall-stun" — "the third-hit dash into a wall stuns you", "never stand near terrain where he can pull-stun you", "Land the Q3 wall-stun", "he can no longer wall-stun you", "dodge his wall-stun". It also says Ntofo Strikes out-ranges Mortal Steel.
audit.why: Ntofo Strikes at 2 stacks "fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in" — it does not stun and does not involve a wall. The stun is Path Maker (W): he charges up taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning. The wall interaction belongs to R, which launches the target through walls. And both Qs are 450 range, so nothing is out-ranged.
audit.corrected: Split the mechanics correctly across five fields: Q pulls, Path Maker stuns on a 14s cooldown, R is the wall launch. Also stated the fact that decides level 6 — when All Out, Path Maker "no longer knocks back or stuns".
sources: mirror audit ksante__yone removed the same claim

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t names anti-heal but nothing on the page says when it matters.
audit.why: All Out grants healing on a 120s cycle — an extended fight taken inside his ultimate is exactly where Grievous Wounds decides the outcome. The item recommendation was there without the timing that makes it useful.
audit.corrected: Put the timing into breakdown.mid, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.why: His abilities mark you to take more damage on his NEXT attack, so the burst arrives on an attack wind-up rather than a cast — the marked auto is the moment to be gone.

edits.after: Through levels 3-5 it stays skill-expressive: you can W Spirit Cleave to shield his pokes and E-flex out of his all-in, but a good K'Sante still trades even. At 6 All Out heals him and reforms his abilities — Path Maker loses its stun in that form, so fight him inside it and bring Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Once your first item lands the matchup tilts hard toward you — your dashes, W shield and R Fate Sealed let you dodge his wall-stun and burst him before All Out matters. Two items in, a farmed Yone simply outscales this tank; play for lane priority then teamfights.
edits.after: Once your first item lands the matchup tilts hard toward you — your dashes, W shield and Fate Sealed let you dodge Path Maker's stun and burst him before All Out heals it back. Two items in, a farmed Yone outscales this tank; play for lane priority then teamfights.

notes: The 'Q3 wall-stun' this page repeated in five fields does not exist: Ntofo Strikes' 2-stack cast is a shockwave PULL, the stun is Path Maker, and the wall launch is All Out's opening knockback. The mirror audit stripped the same invented mechanic from K'Sante's side. Also removed 'All Out shreds your armour' — the reduced defenses in Riot's text are K'Sante's own. spikes[2].text still names 'Immortal Shieldbow/Kraken' while report[8] recommends Blade of the Ruined King; I aligned the text away from the item names rather than pick a build.
